mcp.name: sov-citizen-mcp
mcp.description: Per-user sovereign citizen spawner (qwen2.5:0.5b → llama3.2:3b → free GPU). Read the decision ledger for live citizens.

tools.name: list_citizens
tools.description: List recent sovereign citizens from the decision ledger. Each entry has citizen_id, model, location, last handoff.

tools.name: spawn_citizen
tools.description: Spawn a sovereign AI citizen for an anonymous session. Returns the citizen_id, model, location. Appends a SIGIL-signed record to the decision ledger so the SovSpace Galaxy shows the new node.

anon_session.description: opaque session identifier (e.g. browser cookie hash)

estimated_24h_tokens.description: expected token usage in the next 24h; drives tier selection

tools.name: handoff_citizen
tools.description: Re-tier an existing citizen to a different model/location. The Galaxy node dims as it moves off-local and brightens as it lands on free GPU.

resources.name: recent citizens
resources.description: last 50 spawn/handoff events from the decision ledger
